# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Prissy  <sub>[v3 c3 P14](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0014)</sub>; Pris  <sub>[v3 c6 P12](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0012), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is a pale, spiritual-looking girl with fair skin and lovely hair, who grows to be taller than most of her peers. She dresses elegantly, on one occasion wearing a silk outfit.

_Sources: [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006)_

## Personality

Though she appears pale and spiritual on the outside, Priscilla is full of mischief, fun, and pranks. She possesses a playful humor and a romantic spirit, expressing poetic thoughts and dreaming of fame. She is a loyal friend who enjoys lively banter, yet she maintains a practical, resolute approach to everyday plans.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034), [v3 c3 P14](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0014), [v3 c4 P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070), [v3 c6 P12](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0012), [v3 c10 P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056)_

- To achieve a higher education at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and Stella Maynard, forming a close circle of thoughtful, ambitious friends. After graduating, she taught at Carmody school before taking over her home school. During her time teaching, she contributed to the Avonlea Village Improvement Society by writing papers for their meetings and helped introduce her famous aunt, author Charlotte E. Morgan, to her friends. Later, Priscilla secured her father's permission to pursue a B.A. at Redmond College in Kingsport, where she boarded with Anne. During their second year, she and her friends rented Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue, establishing a cozy home with Aunt Jamesina as their housekeeper. After completing her studies at Redmond, Priscilla married a handsome foreign missionary and relocated with him to Japan.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c3 P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c9 P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v4 c1 P22](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0022), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_
